note: Somalia: the Immigration and Citizenship Agency issues work permits to foreign nationals employed in Somalia, and processes business and work visas; its requirements for the permit aren't published yet. No performers' route or exemption was found, so no days are modelled. Read on the Agency's services page.

sources.title: Immigration and Citizenship Agency (Somalia), Services
sources.said: The Agency processes and issues work permits for foreign nationals employed in Somalia, supporting lawful employment while protecting the domestic labour market. ... Business and work visa processing
